definition: the same checkpoint runs closed loop in plain MuJoCo (C, CPU); observations, goal, reward and termination are computed analytically from the simulator state; replaying a logged trajectory does not count
contract: exported in the Pod by scripts/export_sim2sim_contract.py: g1_nominal.mjb (compiled nominal model) + contract.json (timestep 0.005, decimation 4, solver settings, actuator order, action scale/offset, default pose, soft joint limits, env origin)
init: logged Warp state at step 0 of each clip (reference first frame)
termination: paper rule re-evaluated on the CPU state: root height error 0.25 m, tilt 0.8 (gravity projection)
gates_before_closed_loop: validate: analytic reward on logged Warp states vs logged reward (sum within 0.3%)
openloop: logged actions replayed from logged states, state error vs horizon (median root error < 1 mm at 8 steps)
implementation: tools/sim2sim/sim2sim_mujoco_cpu.py validate|openloop|closed (.venv-sim, mujoco version must equal the exporter's)
not_covered: sensor noise, actuator delay, contact-parameter mismatch; same MJCF and same solver family (this checks the simulator implementation, not model error)
